All 26 ledger identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material, protected opening and ending, and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.
Psytox Mer material was excluded from resolution because the available description was release-level and did not establish which exact track carried the fractured, hypnotic or spacious behaviour.

Current and adjacent alternatives were excluded when descriptions emphasized peak-time intensity, relentless pressure, party escalation, vocal or melodic dominance, or only generic hypnotic/deep terminology.

Overlooked catalogue alternatives were excluded when exact-track descriptions emphasized hooks, distortion, abrasive pressure or high energy, when verified tempo made every non-protected position unlawful, or when the only plausible function duplicated Octagon, a release hinge, or the protected ending.
No lead was admitted for novelty, popularity, duration, BPM, artist reputation, label reputation, or quota completion.
